description:
Goal: Cover uncovered lib/zaq_web/live/bo/system/system_config/llm_tab.ex lines 81, 171, 239 with behavioral tests only. No production/operation changes. Action reuse: not applicable: this work renders an existing pure BO form component; it creates no operation, Action, tool, workflow step, external side effect or execution boundary. Existing source owner: ZaqWeb.Live.BO.System.SystemConfig.LLMTab (@moduledoc: BO system configuration tab component). Test only.

Test-first implementation step — add test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/system_config/llm_tab_test.exs (new, sibling to global_tab_test.exs and ai_credentials_tab_test.exs). use ExUnit.Case, async: true; import Phoenix.LiveViewTest, Phoenix.Component.to_form/2 and Ecto.Changeset.add_error/3; alias Zaq.System.LLMConfig and ZaqWeb.Live.BO.System.SystemConfig.LLMTab. Build a small local render_panel(errors) helper: %LLMConfig{} |> LLMConfig.changeset(%{}) |> Enum.reduce(errors, fn {field, message}, cs -> add_error(cs, field, message) end) |> Map.put(:action, :validate) |> to_form(as: :llm_config); render_component(&LLMTab.panel/1, form: form, credential_options: [], model_options: [], capabilities: %{}). Use distinct literal error strings to identify exact field ownership, and parse returned HTML with Floki. Assert escaped/visible text in the adjacent error paragraph of the named input rather than only html =~ error (which would pass if misplaced). E.g. Floki.find(html, ~s(input[name=\"llm_config[model]\"] + p)) |> Floki.text(); similarly max_cosine_distance and fusion_vector_weight. If selector string escaping is fragile, assert via Floki parsed parent field group scoped to its input; do not weaken field-locality assertions.

Scenario 1 (line 81): Inject an explicit :model error into an action=:validate changeset with model_options: [] so the text-input branch renders; assert displayed translated error directly below llm_config[model], and no such text under another field. Assert name and phx-change=validate_llm on form to confirm real component path. Optional companion render with nonempty model_options to verify searchable-select branch also keeps model error in its own container, if existing SearchableSelect markup permits stable field-local assertions.
Scenario 2 (line 171): Inject :max_cosine_distance error (e.g. 'must be less than or equal to 2'); assert the exact message directly below llm_config[max_cosine_distance], distinct from the persistent cosine-distance help text, and absent from vector field. Assert valid rendering without error has no error paragraph under this input, so helper text alone cannot satisfy the test.
Scenario 3 (line 239): Inject :fusion_vector_weight error (e.g. 'must be less than or equal to 1'); assert the exact message directly below llm_config[fusion_vector_weight] within #llm-fusion-advanced, distinct from the BM25 field; assert #llm-fusion-advanced retains its hook/id. In a companion case, inject separate :fusion_bm25_weight and :fusion_vector_weight errors and verify each appears only by its respective input, preventing swapping the two error bindings.

Functional specs/branches: model error loop, max cosine distance error loop, vector fusion error loop; no-error baseline and sibling-field locality. All via real LLMTab.panel/1 and Phoenix component form. Reuse LLMConfig.changeset/2, render_component/2 and Ecto.Changeset.add_error/3; no production helper or mock. Avoid database/network, secrets, global state and sleeps; async true, no Mox required. Property test not warranted: finite named field bindings, no new normalization/invariant or broad input domain. No new feature E2E: existing component error rendering is a regression test; human UX/UI approval gate remains untouched. No documentation changes planned.

Validation for eventual implementing agent (not run in planning): run mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/system_config/llm_tab_test.exs then mix q per workflow; address failures without weakening assertions. Coverage report/coverup only in authorized coverage phase; final mix precommit at appropriate final approval stage. Check for overlapping tests added by concurrent agents before editing. Scope only new test file, no edits to source. No dependency on other planned work.
title: [zaq-aj9] Cover LLM tab field validation error rendering
